mechanism: Gemfibrozil may potentiate the effects of tranylcypromine through additive effects on lipid metabolism and potential inhibition of monoamine oxidase metabolism, with gemfibrozil also having mild hypolipidemic effects that could alter tranylcypromine pharmacokinetics.
action: Monitor for signs of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis; consider alternative fibrate therapy or use cautiously with frequent clinical monitoring; assess necessity of combination therapy.
